scheme_name: National Awards For Empowerment Of Persons With Disabilities: National Awards For Institutions Engaged In Empowering Persons With Disabilities: Divyangjanon Ke Sashaktikaran Men Karyrat Sarveshrestha Sansthan (Private Organization, NGO)
other_conditions: Must be an organization (private, NGO, society, trust or Section 8 company) working for the empowerment of persons with disabilities
Must have at least 10 years of experience after registration under the Society Act, Trust Act or Section 8 of the Companies Act 2013
Must be registered under the Society Act, Trust Act or Section 8 of the Companies Act 2013
Nominations can be made by any State/UT/Autonomous Body/PSU or a non‑governmental organization registered under the same Acts
benefits_summary: Awardees receive a certificate and shield, and the Department covers boarding, lodging, travel and TA/DA expenses for the awardees and one escort.
